scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

Spaulding’s 1995 article is cited for the existence of a competing interpretation of the baqt. Its descriptive abstract was read at https://africabib.org/rec.php?DB=i&RID=146928466; direct JSTOR access returned no article body. No full-paper review or adoption of its entire reconstruction is claimed. The card does not assign a fixed number of people or goods to every exchange.

Makkura is retained as the existing map label and canonical ID, with Makuria explained in the overview and summary. Makurap is a different South American entity and is not associated. Old Dongola/Tungul is distinguished from modern Dongola and from the later smaller kingdom centred on the old city. Most excavated examples concern the capital; the land documents come from northern Nubia and are located explicitly at Qasr Ibrim.

PCMA pages returned a CrowdSec challenge directly. Their indexed site descriptions and project results were read, including the complete historical/site description, House A paragraph and Polish 2024 floor-results report. No challenge bypass, complete website review or image inspection is claimed. Failed PDF downloads of the 2013 guide and 2021 community booklet returned HTML and were not used as if read. The 2013 beads and Mosque Building articles and 2020 literacy article were downloaded and relevant sections read in full text.

The capital’s fifth/sixth-century beginnings, sixth-century Christianization and broad later phases are distinguished from the imported map coverage of 500 to 1492. The PCMA site gives the court departure as 1364; the 2024 households article gives 1365. Public copy therefore uses the 1360s, with circa phase boundary 1365. No single final conquest, successor relation or historical lifespan override is fabricated.

The cotton article’s indexed Medieval period paragraph 47 was read for the baqt after 651/652. The full article is access-challenged. Its historical framework is qualified because the interpretation and transmission of treaty terms are debated. No exact tribute headcount, universal permanent peace or claim that every agreement survives in an original signed document is added. The bead paper’s erroneous six-century interval from 651 to 1172 is not repeated.

House A is a specific excavated suburban residence, not evidence for toilets or hot water in every home. No modern plumbing standard, flush mechanism or precise construction year is assumed. Toilet paper claims from tertiary summaries were excluded because the relevant underlying guide chapter was unavailable. The 2024 floor results describe four compounds spanning fourteenth to seventeenth centuries; comparison samples and chemical associations are not a complete inventory of foods or an unambiguous map of every activity.

The 2024 household paper was read for its abstract, historical setting, model compound, methods limitations and selected results about shared/separate food preparation. Floor fill can contain redeposited traces from earlier occupation. The public text does not equate an architectural unit with a securely established biological family or portray later Funj-period life as unchanged early Makurian custom.

Łajtar 2020 pages 17 to 19 support named dishes, bilingual texts and exercise ostraca. Rough handwriting is evidence interpreted as learning, not a secure age or universal school enrolment. No high population literacy rate, two-choir performance, or full translation of every inscription is claimed. Pottery fragments and wall texts are not silently classified as manuscripts on paper.

The 2019 land-sale article was downloaded and pages 89 to 96 and relevant later discussion read. Its P.QI 3 36 conversion is November 1,1191, while the quoted Ruffini discussion uses1190. The card attributes1191 and records the discrepancy rather than hiding it. Kapopi’s particular inheritance and sale do not establish universal gender equality or a single inheritance rule. Northern Nubian land sales do not automatically make every local institution an independent state. No contemporary legal guidance is given.

The 2013 bead article pages681 to682 and688 were read closely. Its foundation-deposit interpretation is cited as such, and the necklace need not have been worn. Shell alterations are observations; claims about fertility, protection, currency and specific wearer identities are not generalized. Materials do not establish a direct trading itinerary. The 2017 dancing-princess interpretation was not used because a later correction was identified and had not been fully read.

The Mosque Building paper was read for phases, construction and the 1317 inscription. Earlier royal-audience function is interpreted, while the inscription independently supports the dated conversion. This does not make1317 a universal conversion date for Nubia. Modern mosque closure/conservation claims are not recast as current access conditions.

The 2023 painting announcement was read in indexed pages1 to2, while direct access was challenged. The royal name and scene interpretation are preliminary. Its speculative siege scenario, crusade analogy and first-ever sack claims are excluded. The chamber lay below a later house floor but was originally well above the contemporary medieval ground, so it is not labelled an underground tomb. No images were inspected or reproduced.

All public passages are author-checked and await independent review. Source, schema and visual checks do not certify border accuracy or historical depth. Modern discoveries and study dates are visibly separated from the selected medieval year, while broad medieval practices remain undated rather than assigned invented years.

proposedOverrides.summary: Makkura is a name for Makuria, the medieval Nubian kingdom whose capital was Dongola, also called Tungul. Excavated houses, churches, workshops and texts reveal a city on the Nile in present-day Sudan.

identityEvidence.assessment: Makkura outline along the Sudanese Nile, south of Nobatia and north of Alwa, matches the intended Makuria identity. Imported summary lead also targets Makuria. No precise border certification or shared card with Nobatia is implied.
